Maya (Marketing): Quick idea 1: tiny launch: 25-minute micro-webinar + benchmark story + 75 starter credits. Focus: dev-first demo, 3 quick wins. Thoughts?
Theo (Growth): Love micro format. We should bake in a one-click run button for each prompt so attendees see instant token usage.
Iris (Product): We can expose three curated prompt templates in the console and highlight expected latency & cost per call as part of the benchmark narrative. That helps set expectations.
Priya (Onboarding): Activation flow: sign-up -> immediate 25 credits unlocked -> attend webinar to unlock remaining 50. That split reduces churn from spammers.
Jon (Ops): Routing note: route webinar demo traffic to a dedicated small pool `demo-pool-v2` and shadow traffic to hosted. Add a soft throttle for unknown IP ranges.
Maya (Marketing): Landing copy draft: "Build with Redwood in 25 minutes. Live prompts, end-to-end demo, and 75 free credits to try in your app." Keep it punchy.
Theo (Growth): Experiment matrix: Variant A (75 upfront), Variant B (25 upfront + 50 after checklist), Variant C (25 + progressive 25 after two actions). Measure activation funnel & credit consumption.
Iris (Product): Prompt packs: "Launch Post Generator", "API Error Explainer", "Feature PR Draft". Each pack with 2 starter prompts and a tiny tweak guide. We'll include expected token counts for each example.
Priya (Onboarding): Checklist proposal: 1) create API key, 2) run example prompt, 3) paste generated output into a sample app snippet. Completion grants 50 credits.
Jon (Ops): Example route config (pseudo):
```
routes:
  - name: demo-seed-apr
    pool: demo-pool-v2
    max_qps: 80
    fallback_pool: hosted-standard
    cohorts: ["seed-micro-apr2026"]
```
Maya (Marketing): Webinar format: 10m demo (3 prompts), 10m quick hacks (tuning prompts), 5m Q&A. CTAs: "Claim prompt pack" and "Run in your app".
Theo (Growth): Tracking: landing->signup CVR, attendance %, starter first-run (first 10 tokens), 7-day API usage, cost-per-activated-user. Also watch average token burn during live demo.
Iris (Product): We'll instrument per-prompt telemetry (latency, avg tokens) and surface a benchmark table in the post-webinar email. Narrative: "See how a 50-token prompt costs $0.00X and runs in ~130ms on our demo pool."
Priya (Onboarding): UI gating: show progress modal and an unobtrusive banner that credits will unlock on completion. Who owns the modal? @Iris?
Iris (Product): I'll take modal UX. Priya, can you draft the copy for the 3-step checklist by EOD?
Priya (Onboarding): On it. Draft: `1. Create API key`, `2. Run "Launch Post" prompt`, `3. Save prompt to library`.
Jon (Ops): Policy: credits expire in 28 days, per-user cap 150 credits from promotion. I'll add guard rails to prevent bulk grant abuse.
Maya (Marketing): Promotion plan: in-app banner to seed cohort, targeted LinkedIn ad to dev leads, partner newsletter blurb. Also coordinate a short benchmark blog post to publish same day.
Theo (Growth): A/B note: holdout 30% exposed to upfront 75 credits copy to compare long-term retention vs gated release.
MeetBot: Event scheduled: "Micro Launch: 25m demo + credits" on 2026-04-09 18:00 UTC. Attendees: Maya, Theo, Iris, Jon, Priya.
Maya (Marketing): Action items: Iris 1 modal + prompt packs, Priya 1 checklist copy, Jon 1 route + quota, Theo 1 experiment wiring + metrics, I'll do landing + ad copy. Draft landing link: https://docs.google.com/example-micro-launch
Theo (Growth): I'll set experiment cohorts and send a short brief. Planning retention snapshot at day7 and day30.
Priya (Onboarding): Quick Q: should we show the remaining credit balance in the modal or keep it in account billing page? My vote: show in modal for immediate feedback.
Iris (Product): Modal visible + small confetti on completion :tada:. Less support noise.
Jon (Ops): Note: limit per-org grants to 3 users in case of large teams. We'll add org checks.
Maya (Marketing): Great. Let's reconvene after landing draft. Thanks team :sparkles:
